summary: AssistantShell and AssistantWorkspace take modes. With 'fullscreen' in it the header shows a layout menu (sidebar, window, full screen) instead of the detach/dock button; a single mode hides the layout control.
howTo: Pass modes={['sidebar', 'floating', 'fullscreen']} to AssistantWorkspace or AssistantShell. A layout outside modes falls back (full screen to defaultMode, otherwise the first entry); one entry removes the layout control and the layout shortcut. A renderButton receives expanded and controls for the new 'mode' and 'history' buttons (map to aria-expanded / aria-controls, and aria-haspopup="menu" for 'mode'). New optional labels layout, sidebar, floating and icons fullscreen, history.
